limitations: Static sites are not executed-case counts, semantic equivalence or maintenance savings.

Observed gaps are retained, not declarations that operations may be safely collapsed.
Only multi-file groups are output; this is cross-file discovery, not a rejection of local helpers.

recipe: Resolve package.json test:product quoted .test.ts globs through resolveRouteTestFiles.
Parse each selected file with TypeScript, recording SHA256 and static test()/it() declarations.
Cluster direct call names without type inference; retain receiver and argument-field evidence.
Within each lexical block pair consecutive primary calls; retain intervening statement and direct assertion counts.

A basic node path is a consecutive run of at least two linkNodes calls with exactly sourceNodeId/targetNodeId/type properties, the same receiver and literal type, and matching target/source expression text. Other statements terminate the run.
Review source contracts and consumers before recommending any extraction; static similarity alone is insufficient.
